offering_description.value: The company finances radiosurgery and radiation therapy equipment for hospitals and medical centers. It puts up capital for the equipment and helps hospital partners develop treatment programs.

quotes.quote: As a leading provider of radiosurgical and radiation therapy equipment, American Shared Hospital Services (ASHS) has the talent, knowledge, and infrastructure to provide maximum benefit to our medical center partners through our innovative financing solutions.
Our philosophy is simple. We invest the capital required for the technology our hospital partners need today and provide the tools they need to create successful programs.
